name: kagent-dotnet
tagline: Brings Microsoft Agent Framework agents into the kagent ecosystem via A2A.
problem: .NET developers using Microsoft Agent Framework cannot plug their agents into kagent.
solution: An A2A-based integration between kagent and Microsoft Agent Framework.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Complete package: blog, project video and repository all cited by the organizer.
Bridges an ecosystem the organizer's project did not reach — expands the sponsor's user base.

lessons: An integration that opens the sponsor's project to a new developer community is a reliable sponsor-lane play.
